# monotaur_service_account (Resource)

Manages a Monotaur service account. Service accounts are non-human identities used for programmatic API access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monotaur_service_account" "ci_bot" {
  name        = "ci-bot"
  description = "Service account used by the CI/CD pipeline"
  disabled    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the service account.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description of the service account.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the service account is disabled. Defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the service account was created (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the service account (assigned by the API).
